articles.title: The Ethereum Foundation is facing a wave of high-profile departures as its internal shakeup deepens
articles.snippet: The turnover comes as the foundation undergoes an internal transition tied to a new organizational mandate aimed at redefining its role within Ethereum.

articles.title: Bitcoin Depot, North America's largest bitcoin ATM operator, files for bankruptcy
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Depot, the largest bitcoin ATM operator in North America and publicly listed on Nasdaq, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

articles.title: Bitcoin Depot stock crashes 71% premarket after Chapter 11 filing
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Depot files for Chapter 11 in Texas, plans asset sale and wind-down as regulatory pressure forces shutdown of its Bitcoin ATM network.

articles.title: Grayscale, VanEck amend US spot BNB ETF filings, stepping closer to potential launch
articles.snippet: The US securities regulator approved 21Shares’ Hyperliquid ETF last week, adding to a growing number of cryptocurrencies converted into ETF wrappers in the US.

articles.title: Hyperliquid Defies Market Downturn as SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI IPOs Loom
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid’s HYPE token has jumped as its HIP-3 pre-IPO perp marketplace heats up ahead of a series of high-profile tech IPOs.
